name: CSS Dup Demo
description: Repro extension: popup + 2 content scripts all import the same tailwind.css. Inspect .output to see it duplicated per-entrypoint instead of shared once.

content_security_policy.sandbox: script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' http://localhost:3000; sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; child-src 'self';
